overal.goal: UI redesign phase 5 (spec section 7 and 4.2 Settings): split Settings into five short pages (Project, Agents, Budgets, API keys, Automation), each with a sticky Save footer and a 'changed elsewhere, reload' notice instead of a silent reset; API keys can be created, rotated and revoked with every scope listed; budgets editable. Replaces components/SettingsPage.tsx, CommandsTab.tsx, ClientsSection.tsx, Budget.tsx and their styles.css rules. Covers the older goals ui-settings-form-keeps-edits, ui-clients-rotate-and-scopes, ui-project-overrides and ui-linkable-tabs (settings part).
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI (shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4), vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-ui-redesign-design.md before changing code.
Write a failing test first where the change is logic (src/lib, server); keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx prettier --check . && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
Write a phase 5 plan before building.
Meet the text of the merged goal goals/ui-linkable-tabs/goal.boof.xml.
Meet the text of the merged goal goals/ui-project-overrides/goal.boof.xml.
Meet the text of the merged goal goals/ui-settings-form-keeps-edits/goal.boof.xml.
Meet the text of the merged goal goals/ui-clients-rotate-and-scopes/goal.boof.xml.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Carried over from the UI redesign (phase 3 final review, 2026-10-29); not started.

tests.strategy: Screenshots light, dark, 420 px and desktop of every changed screen, checked against the spec's Global Constraints; unit tests for any src/lib logic.
